notes.title: Small Patch Coming
notes.content:
We have acknowledged  that there's a bug that stops player in the intro.
We are currently investigating on the why and hows. A small patch will be released in the meantime.
If you have troubles, for the time being, select the "I already know how to cook" option in the new game menu to avoid the bug altogether.

notes.title: Let's Cook Some More!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43319889/91297874453bff565f07c919f4518cb7cb2ff743.pngFirst and foremost, thank you for your support. Your criticism, both positive and negative has given us the drive to push through hardships and we are currently updating the game to make it more enjoyable, even for players who have played and finished the story, yes, there will be surprises for you too!
We hope you're hungry. Because we're Cooking for you.
"The Cooking Class" is the first chapter of a family story, we're currently developing the prequel chapter which will shed light upon the origin of the Dupont Family, and while doing that, we're also taking our time to better the first Chapter.
We really believe you will enjoy exploring deep into the lore of the next chapters. The interlude of the prequel will be released as soon as possible as a free test of the game. Just like a demo, but not quite. Is gonna be pivotal a part of the story.
We want you to know that we have read and answered every comment, we listened to your suggestions, because what's cooking if the person eating doesn't like it? A recipe has gotta be perfected. Little by little.
Here's a list of what you will find in the next update, which should be available in the next month or so.

- More lore and files
- Different lighting and Post Processing
- An alternative finale
- Field of focus implementation
- A very well hidden easter egg (not for eating purposes)

Thanks for your love, patience, and support.
The Devs Team

notes.title: Update coming soon - New Languages, New features
notes.content:
Hi chefs and players! We carefully listened to all of your positive and negative feedbacks and we're working on a big update that should improve the game quality. 

New language (Italian for now) and new features are coming soon. We've been through all of your comments, we've watched Youtube and Twitch vids and we're working with dedication to give you the best possible experience.
We've found and cooked the bug of the screen resolution that caused problems to many players, and we deeply apologize for that.
We're also adding new features that should make more spicy your cooking class.

Thank you for all the love and support.

Another Dev Company

Thank you for your patience and trust in us!
